title: Ozone in gaseous and aqueous phases as a sanitizing agent for grapes used in winemaking and its impact on the implantation of Lachancea thermotolerans
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00168D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yaiza Rodríguez, Juan Manuel del Fresno, Carmen González, María Antonia Bañuelos, Antonio Morata
Ozone, applied in the gaseous or aqueous form, effectively sanitizes grapes and enhances Lachancea thermotolerans implantation during fermentation improving wine acidity and changing the aroma profile even with lower yeast inoculum concentrations.
